hint_1: Scratched under the pipes: Interest first. Then fees. Debt last. Debt is always last.
hint_2: A clerk's note: Misc, widows, wells, orphans. Alphabetical was too honest.

lines: A brass seal nailed to a pipe: 'Property of the Veil. So is this pipe. So are you, if you stand here long.'
A brass seal on a bucket. The bucket has a contract. The contract has a bucket.
A brass seal stamped on a tiny chair. Someone small worked off a debt here.
A brass seal on the strongroom bell: 'Ring for service. Pay for silence.'
A brass seal on a ledger cabinet. It's warm. Ledgers here are kept by the fire, in case.
An IOU: 'Hadi the potter owes the Veil one kiln, two domes and his good thumb.'
An IOU: 'Ranya owes forty sacks of pepper. Interest payable in sneezes.'
An IOU: 'Sefa owes the well. The whole well. Signed under protest, then signed again.'

iou_empty: Nothing left here but a smell of ink and regret.

lines: The Veil's order book. 'Three graves, prepaid: K. (retired), Q. (thief), and the map kid (pending).'

orders_read: The Veil's order book. Most entries end in 'collected'.

lines: A note on the counter: 'Out collecting. Back when the sun moves again. Touch nothing. Everything is counted. L.'

note_gone: The note is gone. Someone is back.

lines: Factor Lusk: You again. Let's not fight. Sign this truce and your debts vanish. Have a seat. I'll get the door.
Factor Lusk: Fine. We'll do it the expensive way. I'll invoice your next of kin.

lusk_after: Factor Lusk: Bankrupt. Do you know what that's like? No. You never had anything to lose.
vault_caught: You wedge the door with a ledger before it can shut. Lusk sighs. 'Qadir. Of course. I should have bought him.'
vault_struck: The door clicks shut behind you. From the other side, Lusk's guards. 'Signature or shovel. Your choice.'
vault_defeat: Factor Lusk: ...My Spirlings, my brass, my strongroom. All written off.
Factor Lusk: Take the vault key. Corin will want it. He always wanted everything of mine, the vulture. So proud.
vault_lose: Factor Lusk: Collected. Come back when you're solvent.
ledger_vault: Factor Lusk offered you a truce in his strongroom and locked the door behind you while you read it.
guards_lose: The Veil guards take a fee for your release. They give you a receipt. It's very nicely printed.
sign: THE BRASS VEIL - CISTERN AND COUNTING HOUSE
Water sold by the cup. Souls by arrangement.
clerk_ivo: Ivo: I count buckets. Some days the buckets count me.
clerk_ivo_intro: Ivo: Unauthorised visitor. That's a fine. Fight me and it's two fines.
clerk_ivo_defeat: Ivo: Write it down as... no, don't write it down.
guard_pell: Orla: I guard water. Tried drinking on shift once. They docked a week.
guard_pell_intro: Orla: Nobody gets past. Nobody's paid me to let them.
guard_pell_defeat: Orla: Fine, go. I'll tell them you bribed me. Did you? No? Pity.
clerk_mott: Quill: I run debts across town. Fastest legs in Solenne. Need them.
clerk_mott_intro: Quill: You owe me a duel. Everybody owes me something.
clerk_mott_defeat: Quill: Ran out of Spirlings. Running out of town next.
auditor_nell: Nell: I audit the auditors. Somebody has to distrust the distrustful.
auditor_nell_intro: Nell: Your numbers don't add up. Let me subtract some.
auditor_nell_defeat: Nell: Rounding error. Mine. Don't tell anyone.
guard_brack: Brack: My last job was breaking legs. This one's breaking spirits. Better hours.
guard_brack_intro: Brack: Valves don't turn themselves. Neither do I.
guard_brack_defeat: Brack: Broken. Me, I mean. Spirit's fine.
